A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same BayesG research work. Their main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–I are readable and can be matched despite repagination.

before.justification: v3 reports original SUMO traffic-control experiments, ablations, training-loss analyses and case studies in Section 5 and Appendices E–G.

after.justification: v4 retains the original experimental results across five traffic environments, including ablations and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Definition 5 replaces the incorrect expanded regularizer with negative KL(q||p). Algorithm 1 changes separate descent on the ELBO to joint actor/graph descent on negative ELBO. These materially correct the specified objective and update direction, although the PDFs do not establish implementation changes or reruns.

E1.justification: Both evaluate ATSC_Grid, Monaco, NewYork33, NewYork51 and NewYork167. The represented traffic networks, tasks and appendix test scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: The evaluated baselines remain IA2C, ConseNet (Consensus in Figure 2), FPrint (FingerPrint), LToS, CommNet and NeurComm. Comparator membership also matches in the qualitative comparisons and ablations.

E3.justification: The scenario-specific control intervals, episode lengths, observations, rewards, A2C backbone and evaluation procedures remain unchanged. No separate revision to the experimental design is reported.

E4.justification: Figure 5 retains the masking-strategy and input-feature ablations. Appendices E–G retain the same loss analyses, traffic snapshots and case studies across times and training runs.

E5.justification: Both report averages over five random seeds and retain the same shaded training curves and per-seed appendix loss traces. No uncertainty-reporting or statistical-estimation procedure changes.

E6.justification: The plotted results and qualitative panels in Figures 2–5 and 7–11 are unchanged, as are Table 1's graph statistics and the reported findings. No numerical result entries are added, removed or revised.

T1.justification: Appendix A.3 corrects the swapped prior/posterior probabilities and entropy sign in v3 Equation 32. v4 Equation 36 correctly combines the expected log prior with positive mask entropy to obtain negative KL(q||p), matching revised Definition 5. This repairs central mathematical reasoning rather than merely changing notation.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the claims of stochastic local graph policies, Bayesian graph inference integrated with actor–critic learning, and improved traffic coordination at scales up to 167 agents.

C2.justification: The interpretations of selective communication, directional cooperation and training-loss dynamics are retained. Appendix I preserves the same limitations concerning fixed topology, local observability, hyperparameter sensitivity and computational cost.

D1.justification: v4 adds a Section 5.1 footnote providing a code-and-data repository link, absent from v3. The linked resources were not inspected; the existing implementation and environment disclosures are otherwise retained.

R1.justification: Section 6.1 removes the specific mean-field-bounds characterization of Anand and Qu and the suggestion to extend earlier theoretical tools to learned masks. The 49 cited works, central positioning and Appendix H comparison table remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.2 revise and expand the Bayesian motivation, while Section 6.1 condenses its comparison into separate paragraphs. Local wording and spelling edits accompany a retained overall section and appendix structure.

P2.justification: The existing figures and tables are retained with layout adjustments, including grouping Algorithms 1 and 2 and moving Figure 11 before Appendix H. Figure 10's caption adds the density encoding; Figure 11's caption loses its panel (b) explanation, although that panel remains.

improvement.justification: v4 repairs serious inconsistencies in the paper's central ELBO regularizer and optimization direction, bringing Definition 5, Appendix A.3 and Algorithm 1 into substantially better agreement. This materially improves the training specification's mathematical correctness, and the added code/data link improves access information. The empirical results remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish whether the implementation changed.
